question: During which period were the Khilafat movement and Non-Cooperation movement organised to oppose British rule in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **'__1919-1922__'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Two mass movements namely** Khilafat** and** Non-Cooperation movements **were organized **during 1919-1922.**
 
• They started **to oppose British rule in India.**
 
• Despite having different concerns, they adopted a unified plan of** non-violence and non-cooperation**.
 
• The **Muslim League** **and C
ongress unified **during this time. With the help of both of these political parties, numerous protests were held.
